diagnosis: The proof strategy is already optimal: test with f, use nonnegativity to obtain almost-everywhere vanishing, then upgrade to pointwise vanishing by continuity and positive measure on open sets. The refactor removes redundant local annotations and replaces tactic-generated continuity/integrability proofs with direct theorem applications.
proof_body:
by
  have h := hg f hf
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg] at h
  · rw [Continuous.ae_eq_iff_eq] at h
    · ext x
      simpa using congrFun h x
    · exact Continuous.inner' f f hf.smooth.continuous hf.smooth.continuous
    · exact continuous_zero
  · exact fun x => real_inner_self_nonneg' _
  · exact (hf.inner hf).integrable
